# TESERACT Creative Studios

> TESERACT Creative Studios (TESERACT) is a digital creative studio focused on design, technology and experiences. We create interactive, thoughtful and tailor-made digital experiences for businesses that want to be different.

From the first idea to the final interaction, we design and build your digital presence around your business, your audience and your vision.

## Key facts

- Name: TESERACT Creative Studios (TESERACT), spelled with one S. Tesseract is a geometric concept associated with a fourth dimension. For the agency, the name represents thinking beyond the obvious, exploring new dimensions of digital experiences, and building work that goes beyond ordinary websites. Not affiliated with other companies or software named Tesseract.
- Tagline: Build beyond the ordinary.
- Founder: [Gireesh](who-we-are/index.html#founder) — Founder · Product Designer · Business & Technology
- Where we work: Remotely, with businesses, founders and teams across India and worldwide.
- Contact: gireesh.uiux@gmail.com; [contact page](contact/index.html)
- Profiles: Instagram https://www.instagram.com/itsgireesh.uiux/, LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/gireesh-kumar-reddy-kolli-/, GitHub https://github.com/gireeshkumarreddy (the founder's own, used by the studio until it has company pages)

## What we create

- Website Design: Make a great first impression. We design websites that look beautiful, feel intuitive and communicate your business clearly. (UX Strategy, User Journeys, Wireframes, UI Design, Responsive Design, Prototyping, Design Systems, Interaction Design)
- Website Development: From design to reality. We turn the design into a real, responsive and functional website. (Business Websites, Corporate Websites, Landing Pages, CMS Websites, Interactive Websites, Web Applications)
- E-commerce: Make buying feel simple. From discovering a product to completing a purchase, we design every step of the experience. (Product Pages, Shopping Experiences, Cart & Checkout, Payment Integration, Order Management, CMS, Mobile Experiences)
- Interactive & 3D: Don't just show people. Let them experience it. We create digital experiences using motion, interaction and 3D. (Scroll animations, Interactive storytelling, Product interactions, Micro-interactions, Cinematic experiences, 3D environments)
- Brand & Digital Identity: Your brand should feel consistent everywhere. (Typography, Colour Systems, Visual Direction, Digital Identity, Design Systems, Brand Guidelines)
- Product & SaaS: Digital products people actually want to use. (Dashboards, SaaS Platforms, Web Applications, Mobile Interfaces, User Flows, Prototypes, Design Systems)
- AI & Automation: Make your business work smarter. (AI Experiences, Workflow Automation, AI Interfaces, Internal Tools, Intelligent Dashboards, API Integrations)
- Digital Strategy: Before we build, we think. (Digital Positioning, Website Strategy, User Research, Competitor Analysis, Content Structure, Conversion Strategy)

## How we work

1. Understand — First, we listen. Before we design anything, we learn about your business.
2. Define — Then, we find the direction. We turn everything we've learned into a clear plan.
3. Explore — Now we start thinking differently. We explore ideas, layouts, references and visual directions.
4. Design — The idea starts to take shape. Everything starts coming together.
5. Refine — Details make the difference. We review every important detail.
6. Build — Design meets technology. Once the direction is approved, we bring the experience to life.
7. Test — Before people use it, we test it.
8. Launch — Ready for the world. Once everything is tested and approved, we launch.
9. Evolve — Launch is not the end. Businesses change. Your website should be able to change with them.

## What we believe

Simple for people. Powerful for business.
A website should not make people think too hard. It should be easy to understand, easy to explore and easy to remember.
Behind every beautiful experience, there should be a clear purpose.
We make complex things feel simple.

## The founder

Gireesh — Founder · Product Designer · Business & Technology.
With nearly five years of professional experience across aviation, business, technology and digital innovation, Gireesh brings together a multidisciplinary perspective shaped by different industries and disciplines.

## Frequently asked questions

- **What does TESERACT Creative Studios do?** TESERACT is a digital creative studio focused on design, technology and experiences. We create interactive, thoughtful and tailor-made digital experiences for businesses that want to be different.
- **Where do you work?** Remotely, with businesses, founders and teams across India and worldwide.
- **Do I need a perfect brief before we talk?** No. You don't need a perfect brief. You don't need technical knowledge. You don't even need to know exactly what you want yet. Tell us what you have in mind — we'll take it from there.
- **Do you offer fixed packages?** We don't believe in fixed packages. Every business has different goals, audiences and challenges, so we build what makes sense for you.
- **What can you build for us?** Website design, website development, e-commerce, interactive & 3D experiences, brand & digital identity, product & SaaS, AI & automation and digital strategy.
- **Do you build e-commerce websites?** Yes. From discovering a product to completing a purchase, we design every step of the experience: product pages, shopping experiences, cart & checkout, payment integration and order management.
- **Do you design SaaS products and landing pages?** Yes. We design dashboards, SaaS platforms, web applications, user flows and prototypes, and we build landing pages.
- **Will my website look like a template?** No. You don't need another template. Every project starts from zero, built around your business, your audience and your vision.
- **How does a project work?** Understand, define, explore, design, refine, build, test, launch and evolve. We take the time to understand, explore, design, build and refine.
- **What happens after launch?** Launch is not the end. Businesses change, and your website should be able to change with them. We can continue supporting, improving and evolving your digital experience as your business grows.
- **How involved will we be?** We communicate, share progress, ask questions, listen to feedback and build together — because the best results happen when the client isn't just watching the process. They're part of it.
- **What does the name TESERACT mean?** Tesseract is a geometric concept associated with a fourth dimension. For the agency, the name represents thinking beyond the obvious, exploring new dimensions of digital experiences, and building work that goes beyond ordinary websites.

## Client Work

- [Aivinci Creative Studio](projects/aivinci/index.html): AI creative & technology studio; 2026; Client Project. A single-page website for Aivinci Creative Studio, an AI creative and technology studio, showing its AI films, creative technology and digital products. Tagline: “WE CREATE WHAT’S NEXT.” Live site: https://aivinci.ai/
- [Geetha Jewellers](projects/geetha-jewellers/index.html): Jewellery; 2026; Client Project. A one-page website for Geetha Jewellers, a gold and diamond jewellery shop: scroll-animated collections, a store-visit section and gold savings schemes. Tagline: “More than Jewellery, It’s a part of your story”. Live site: https://geetha-seven.vercel.app/
- [AeroSkys](projects/aeroskys/index.html): Travel booking; 2026; Client Project. A travel booking website for AeroSkys to search and book flights, hotels, holiday packages and buses; a working prototype in which bookings are simulated. Tagline: “Book your trip in a few clicks.” Live site: https://aeroskys.vercel.app/
- [Derlin Haus](projects/derlin-haus/index.html): Menswear e-commerce; 2026; Client Project. An online menswear shop for Derlin Haus: shirts, T-shirts and trousers, with category pages, search and filters, size selection and a bag with coupons. Tagline: “WHAT’S INSIDE MATTERS.” Live site: https://derlin-haus.vercel.app/
- [Mahira Select](projects/mahira-select/index.html): Indian ethnic womenswear; 2026; Client Project. An online store for Mahira Select’s Indian ethnic womenswear, from sarees and kurta sets to lehengas, with a cinematic home page, a cart and checkout. Tagline: “More Than Fashion”. Live site: https://mahira2.netlify.app/
- [SAN Media Solution](projects/san-media/index.html): Digital marketing agency; 2026; Client Project. A website for SAN Media Solution, a digital marketing agency: its services, marketing packages and team, and a work page of reels, films and posters. Tagline: “BRANDS TODAY. BIGGER TOMORROWS.” Live site: https://www.sanmediasolutions.com/
- [SIAARA By S&A](projects/siaara/index.html): Handcrafted sarees; 2026; Client Project. An online saree boutique for SIAARA By S&A: handcrafted sarees by weave and colour, product pages, a wishlist, a bag and an English and Telugu switch. Tagline: “SAREES WOVEN WITH CULTURE”. Live site: https://gleeful-belekoy-e52bbe.netlify.app/
- [Vynk Network](projects/vynk/index.html): Travel eSIM; 2026; Client Project. A travel eSIM store for Vynk Network: compare plans by destination and get a QR-code eSIM; in this preview build, accounts, codes and payments are simulated. Tagline: “Global data. No roaming. Total freedom.” Live site: https://vynk-zeta.vercel.app/
- [LiveCV](projects/livecv/index.html): Resume & career platform; 2026; Client Project. A resume-builder website for LiveCV that turns a resume into one permanent live link, shown with example profiles the site labels illustrative. Tagline: “Your career is bigger than a resume.” Live site: https://gireeshkumarreddy.github.io/Livecv/
- [Hidden Stories](projects/hidden-stories/index.html): Short-stay homes, Hyderabad; 2026; Client Project. A website for Hidden Stories, eight short-stay homes in Hyderabad: a scroll-driven story around a home-tour film, then search and booking in demo mode. Tagline: “Your stay. Your story.” Live site: https://gireeshkumarreddy.github.io/hidden/
- [Careers at Aeroskys](projects/aeroskys-careers/index.html): Careers portal; 2026; Client Project. A careers site for Aeroskys, a travel booking company: open roles in three groups, each with its own page, career ladder, hiring process and application. Tagline: “Go further. Grow further.” Live site: https://aeroskys-careers.vercel.app/

Self-initiated concepts and fan projects, not client commissions. Fan pieces are unofficial and not affiliated with the rights holders.

A concept landing page for Sagewell, an invented AI reasoning model for developers and teams, with a prompt composer and a reasoning-trace demo. Tagline: “The model that thinks before it speaks.” Live site: https://gireeshkumarreddy.github.io/landing-concepts/sagewell/
- [Vantline](projects/vantline/index.html): Decision-intelligence SaaS concept; 2026; Concept Project. A concept landing page for Vantline, an invented decision-intelligence copilot that explains what changed in your numbers, shown with sample data. Tagline: “Know what changed and what to do about it.” Live site: https://gireeshkumarreddy.github.io/landing-concepts/vantline/
- [Tidings](projects/tidings/index.html): Chat-commerce SaaS concept; 2026; Concept Project, not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta. A concept landing page for Tidings, an invented chat-commerce platform for small shops and restaurants, with clickable phone chats and a campaign builder. Tagline: “WhatsApp campaigns customers actually want to open”. Live site: https://gireeshkumarreddy.github.io/landing-concepts/tidings/
- [Emberpost](projects/emberpost/index.html): People-first email SaaS concept; 2026; Concept Project. A concept landing page for Emberpost, an invented people-first email app that files every email under its sender, with a clickable sample inbox. Tagline: “Email organised around the people behind it.” Live site: https://gireeshkumarreddy.github.io/landing-concepts/emberpost/
- [Ines Morrow](projects/ines-morrow/index.html): Film editor portfolio concept; 2026; Concept Project. A portfolio concept for Ines Morrow, a fictional film and commercial editor, with a scrubbable reel timeline and a before-and-after colour-grade slider. Tagline: “Cuts that keep people watching”. Live site: https://gireeshkumarreddy.github.io/landing-concepts/creative-portfolio/
- [Maren Holt](projects/maren-holt/index.html): Book editor & newsletter concept; 2026; Concept Project. Live site: https://gireeshkumarreddy.github.io/landing-concepts/maren-holt/

Luffy, told in cinematic, scroll-driven chapters: a fan experiment made for fun and never sold. Tagline: “More than a hat. A promise.” Live site: https://gireeshkumarreddy.github.io/one-piece-/
- [TĀVRA](projects/tavra/index.html): Sportswear concept; 2026; Concept Project. A concept store for TĀVRA, a women’s sportswear concept built on Indian textile crafts such as bandhani, ikat and ajrakh; checkout and payment are off. Tagline: “Women's sportswear drawn from India's textile art.”
- [VELORA](projects/velora/index.html): Fragrance concept; 2026; Concept Project. A concept website for VELORA, a fragrance-house concept built around its signature eau de parfum, with an interactive bottle and notes; ordering is not open. Tagline: “The essence of subtle romance”.
- [AARADHYA](projects/aaradhya/index.html): Saree house concept; 2026; Concept Project. An editorial concept website for AARADHYA, a saree-house concept themed around Maa Durga: a love letter to the saree, to heritage and to the feminine spirit. Tagline: “Maa Durga.”
- [SAANJH](projects/saanjh/index.html): Beverage concept; 2026; Concept Project. A concept website for SAANJH, a drinks-brand concept of bottled Indian-flavoured blends in three flavours: Kesar Cloud, Elaichi Silk and Gulab Velvet. Tagline: “Good things. Slowly savoured.”
- [VYRN](projects/vyrn/index.html): Fashion e-commerce concept; 2026; Concept Project. A fashion storefront concept for VYRN, a concept label of modern essentials, with animated editorial sections, a collection and product pages; payments are off. Tagline: “Modern essentials. Independent expression.”

A concept storefront for Vesper, an architectural-lighting brand concept: a shop, four collections and a day/night mode; no real orders are processed.
